notes.general_comments:
58 candidates took this paper and the mean mark was 12.9 which is very similar to the mean of 12.5 last
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 12, 15, 29 and 30.
These questions were answered correctly by 50% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of
the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions which caused the biggest challenge for candidates were 20 and 21. These questions had few
candidates choosing the correct option and were also answered incorrectly by some, but not all, of the
candidates who did well on the test overall.
